messages.subject: question regarding using multipleGroup() to do concurrent calibration
parts:
Hello,

I got warning messages below. With the same code, I did not encounter this problem when using mirt version 1.09.

 "In ESTIMATION(data = data, model = model, group = rep("all",  ... :
  Information matrix with the crossprod, Louis, and sandwich method
                        do not account for prior parameter distribution information"

Thanks,
Bo

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: question regarding using multipleGroup() to do concurrent calibration
parts:
The warning is indeed new and means what it says. Standard errors with models that contain priors do not contain information about the prior, so generally they are too large. You can try other SE methods as others do support the inclusion of priors.

Phil
